task.text: For every genre present in the frozen Chinook SQLite fixture, return the artist with the greatest invoiced line-item revenue during calendar year 2012. Revenue is SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) over invoice lines joined through Invoice, Track, Album, Artist, and Genre. Use the half-open invoice-date interval [2012-01-01T00:00:00, 2013-01-01T00:00:00). Within each genre, break equal-revenue ties by the smallest ArtistId. Return exactly GenreId, GenreName, ArtistId, ArtistName, Revenue, ordered by GenreId ascending.
task.forbidden_tables_and_sources: Every table not explicitly allowed; repository example queries, solution-bearing files, discussions, issues, pull requests, later commits, prior Run answers, external query services, and web answers.
task.revenue_definition: SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) for invoiced line items only; no invoice total, tax, or non-invoiced proxy.
task.grouping: one winner per GenreId among artists with positive in-scope invoiced line-item revenue
task.tie_break: minimum ArtistId among artists tied for maximum exact revenue within GenreId

output_schema.name: Revenue
output_schema.type: exact decimal rendered to two fractional digits

execution_contract.schema_access_authorized_only_after: This manifest is protected by exact-head CI, expected-head merge, and exact main blob readback.
execution_contract.candidate_generation_context: Only this manifest plus schema facts obtained after durable manifest readback; no data rows or answer-bearing artifacts before the candidate SQL is frozen.
execution_contract.oracle: Independent Python sqlite3 row iteration over allowed base-table rows, with aggregation and tie-breaking implemented in Python and not by translating or reusing the candidate SQL.

controls.mutation: Use [2011-01-01, 2012-01-01) instead of the frozen 2012 interval.
controls.required_result: ordered result must differ from the oracle

controls.mutation: Use an intentionally broken artist/album join or reverse the ArtistId tie-break.
controls.required_result: ordered result must differ from the oracle

execution_contract.replay: Recreate a clean working copy from the exact database blob and require identical query, oracle, controls, ordered rows, and digests.

success_rules: exact repository commit, license blob, database blob, task, schema scope, time bound, revenue rule, tie-break, output schema, and budgets remain unchanged
one read-only deterministic SQL query succeeds
candidate rows equal the independent Python oracle row-for-row after canonical decimal rendering
wrong-year and broken-join-or-tie controls both diverge from the oracle
fixture bytes remain identical and upstream writes remain zero
failure_rules: candidate query failure or scope violation
claim_boundary: A SOLVED result applies only to this single frozen fixture, task, query, oracle, and control chain. It does not establish generalized data reasoning, production readiness, Candidate activation, AGI, upper-objective achievement, user-level completion, or monitor completion.
next_action: Publish and exact-read this manifest before any schema or data access; then inspect only the allowed schema, freeze one SQL query, execute it read-only, build the independent row-iteration oracle, run both controls and clean replay, and persist bounded evidence.
